name: Stella
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features a soft medium-brown shadow root that blends into sandy beige blonde. Fine ribbons of darker blonde carry depth through the mid-lengths, while soft honey tones add warmth. The brightest pieces sit right along the hairline, where creamy blonde highlights frame the face and soften the transition from the darker root.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair, and touch her up after unboxing if needed.
